v2Limitations: No pitch-envelope or vibrato scheduling was implemented in the v2 preview renderer.
The v2 browser song did not author slide/vibrato controls.
Space effects are deterministic random-IR and native delay approximations; they are not recorded browser output.

v3VerifiedSemantics.amplitude: Imports exact local getADSRValues/getParamADSR; stock sample envelope max=1, GM font envelope max=.3; gain*velocity and postgain preserved.
v3VerifiedSemantics.sampleSelection: Nearest named MIDI root; sample n uses getSoundIndex modulo; source rate=abs(speed)*2^(semitoneDifference/12).
v3VerifiedSemantics.pitchEnvelope: Imports exact getPitchEnvelope, including panchor and semitone-to-cent conversion; this returns to its min at note release.
v3VerifiedSemantics.authoredSlide: Browser and renderer share scheduleStaticDetune: smoothstep glide/pick curve, 1 kHz control resolution, settled detune exactly zero.
v3VerifiedSemantics.vibrato: Stock starts sine LFO at note onset; articulated instrument uses shared scheduleVibratoDepth, starts sine phase zero after vibdelay and fades depth over vibattack.
v3VerifiedSemantics.choking: cut groups ramp prior voice to zero over 10ms.
v3VerifiedSemantics.sampleAttack: No sample offset/trim unless event.begin is explicitly authored; note.attack uses Strudel minimum 1ms.

remainingDifferences: Reverb impulse generation and send behavior remain a native-node approximation.
AudioWorklet-only effects are rejected unless allowUnsupportedControls is explicitly selected; do not treat such a render as equivalent.
No browser loopback was captured and no subjective listening claim is made by this audit.

test.comparison: Two identical excerpts RMS match to -22dBFS with a .6s gap; smoke only.

inputSchema.instrumentAliases: optional mapping; roof_live and roof_live_soft are built in aliases
